title: Module locked at an incompatible major
description: go.sum declares a `+incompatible` version in go.sum. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `+incompatible` version in go.sum.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a `+incompatible` version in go.sum.
limitation: It matches a `+incompatible` version in go.sum in the parsed go.sum; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
